before.requirement: Continue an exponent-bearing number across parse_ex calls on the same tokener.
before.reason: The old number state can retain partial text and return for another call, but the harness frees the tokener after its first call.

after.requirement: Continue an exponent-bearing number across parse_ex calls on the same tokener, using its saved exponent text.
after.reason: The new number state explicitly reconstructs exponent state from saved text; the harness still cannot make a second call.

claims.reason: The source’s exponent handling changed, but the concrete harness constraint is identical: one parse_ex call followed by tokener destruction.

before.requirement: Reject an incomplete exponent such as "[0e]" specifically under strict mode.
before.reason: The old number path passes double text to json_parse_double without an incomplete-exponent check or a strict-mode distinction for this case.

after.requirement: Reject incomplete exponents in strict-mode parse_ex calls.
after.reason: The changed parser skips permissive trimming in strict mode and rejects an incomplete exponent; the harness never sets strict flags.

claims.reason: The strict rejection capability is required only after the change, so there is no before-side blocker for this same obligation.

location.dependency_reason: The added cases specify the strict-mode outcome for incomplete exponents.
